messages:
Raj: quick personal update 1 — I said yes! Me and Priya are engaged :ring: Also FYI I accepted an internal transfer to the London office starting Aug 1. planning a small goodbye + engagement cake in the kitchen Friday at 4pm if anyone wants to pop by.
Talia: OMG congrats Raj!!! :tada::heart_eyes: london is lucky to have you. ill bring savory finger foods.
Jordan: double congrats!! ill bring a nut-free cake (labelled).
Sam: yay!! can we make it 4-4:20 so folks on different schedules can swing by? i can help with plates and a sign.
Raj: love that — 4-4:20 works. thanks everyone. Priya says hi and sends biscotti (non-nut) vibes.
People Ops: congrats Raj! reminder: label allergens and keep shared spaces tidy. We can collect a group card and arrange a small bouquet if you DM People Ops by Wed EOD.
Calendar Bot: Event created: "Raj 6 Priya engagement + goodbye" Fri Jul 26 16:00-16:20 (Conference Kitchen). Invite sent to #all.
Talia: sending confetti GIF :confetti_ball: see you Friday!
